name: inspira-animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
blurb: Animated SVG beam connecting two elements with gradient.
description: Renders an animated SVG path with gradient connecting two referenced elements. Configurable curvature, colors, animation speed, and direction.
use_when: Architecture diagrams, flow charts, or connection visualizations between components or concepts.
avoid_when: Many simultaneous animations that could impact performance.
a11y: SVG path is decorative; semantic content provided by the connected elements.
